sources.title: DFlash 2: Keep Drafting Parallel — Inco AI
sources.snippet: DFlash 2 is the successor to our widely deployed parallel drafter: close to 3× the speed of autoregressive decoding, with the same output. Drafters for Qwen3.8-27B and Meta's Muse Glimmer are out today.

sources.title: [2602.06036] DFlash: Block Diffusion for Flash Speculative Decoding
sources.snippet: In this paper, we introduce DFlash, a speculative decoding framework that employs a lightweight block diffusion model for parallel drafting. sources.snippet: Strix Halo llama.cpp toolbox (FA + MoE-prefill fixes) A ready-to-run llama.cpp for AMD Strix Halo (Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S / gfx1151), tuned for long-context, quantized-KV workloads. It bundles a set of Flash-Attention and MoE-prefill fixes plus a current GPU driver, so quantized KV cache is fast instead of a penalty.
